organizer_notice: Only the old MPI CPU samples (MPI_direct_solver / MPI_iterative_solver) labelled seconds as ms because multiplication by 1000 was missing. Serial and GPU units were correct. Official Gitee master now fixes MPI units and uses five untimed warmups followed by five timed official runs. CHECK end to end time is the mean of those final five runs, in milliseconds. Warmups roughly double total runtime. Old unit-only errors can be corrected by multiplying by 1000 or rerunning.
